title: ChatGPT-facilitated Python radar-chart project
summary: Educational-technology students complete a 100-minute Python radar-chart project after four programming sessions. In the experimental variant, students use a gpt-3.5-turbo chat platform as the primary support while coding and debugging a simplified chart and an advanced Holland radar chart.

sources.title: Would ChatGPT-facilitated programming mode impact college students' programming behaviors, performances, and perceptions? An empirical study
sources.evidence_quote: Students were required to complete a radar chart task within 100 min ... ChatGPT Next ... was adopted as a major tool to facilitate students' problem-solving process.

assessment.summary: Develop a Python radar chart, with a simplified chart as the base requirement and a Holland radar chart as the advanced requirement.
student_actions: Ask ChatGPT questions and evaluate or test its responses.
Produce and inspect the chart output.

student_role.description: Students use ChatGPT Next with gpt-3.5-turbo as their main problem-solving support.
